Settings.EnableMobileHint: Automatically switch to mobile-optimized UI on touch devices.
Settings.HideQuickControlsHint: Hides the floating quick controls toolbar on touch devices.
Settings.HideAvatarCarouselHint: Hides the character avatar carousel on touch devices.
Settings.EnableCanvasFreezeHint: Freezes canvas rendering when idle to save battery and prevent heating.
Settings.VramLimitWarningHint: Warn when estimated texture VRAM exceeds this amount (default 400MB for iOS).
